mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM nw_agents a JOIN nw_agent_publications p ON p.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND p.agent_id=a.id AND p.id=a.published_revision_id WHERE a.tenant_id::text=#{tenant} AND a.id::text=#{agent} AND a.status='published' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_workflow_test_sessions wt WHERE wt.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND wt.agent_id=a.id) AND p.snapshot #> '{agent,config,memory,automatic_extraction}' = 'true'::jsonb )
